claim: In TopicEmbed.import, the 'Imported from' footer interpolates url unescaped into a single-quoted <a href='#{url}'> in raw HTML. Because the post uses cook_method raw_html, the sanitizer never runs, so a crafted embed_url allows HTML/JS injection (stored XSS).

When a slot falls inside a date override window, checkIfIsAvailable returns true (`if (dateOverrideExist) return true;`) before the busy.every(...) check. Existing bookings and calendar busy times are ignored on override days, which allows double bookings for fixed and round-robin hosts.
In sync mode, Zoom's expiry_date becomes NaN because fields are dropped, so zoomTokenSchema.parse fails.

The loadUsers rewrite in handleNewBooking.ts changes behavior:
- An empty dynamicUserList throws a plain Error (500) instead of reaching the 404 path.
- Prisma errors are re-thrown as 400 with the raw message.
- Other errors are swallowed.
- The organization slug select is dropped while IsFixedAwareUser still declares it.

AssignmentSource.queued defaults to timezone.now(), which is evaluated once at class definition/import time. Every instance created without an explicit value therefore shares the same stale timestamp instead of getting its own creation time.

After the deleteCache mutation in CredentialActionsDropdown succeeds, it only calls onSuccess and does not invalidate viewer.calendars.connectedCalendars. Callers that pass no onSuccess, such as EventAdvancedTab, then show a stale cacheUpdatedAt / 'Last updated'.

The PR has no changelog or release-note entry for the exit-code renumbering, the new rolling-updates preview feature, or the requirement that update-compatibility now needs --features=rolling-updates.

deleteByIDs in xorm_store.go (around lines 605-608) chooses between paths by checking r.cfg.AnnotationCleanupJobBatchSize > sqliteParameterLimit instead of len(ids) > sqliteParameterLimit. Because of this, small final batches still use the inlined-ID path when the configured batch size is large.

Locales are not normalized to one type (Symbol or String) before the @loaded_locales include? check and insertion. Because :en != 'en', the same locale passed as a String and as a Symbol produces duplicate entries and redundant loads.

OffsetTracker.get_committable_offsets builds list(self.all_offsets.keys()) without a lock while submit threads can insert new partition keys, which can raise during iteration and break the commit loop.
The max_segment_spans safety check in _load_segment_data was removed, so pre-existing oversized Redis sets are processed without Python-side protection.
Backend classes are monkey-patched via send(:include), which is fragile across gem upgrades.

In GetWebAssets, after acquiring the write lock the code does not re-check whether entryPointAssetsCache was already populated by another goroutine. Concurrent cold-cache callers therefore each re-read and re-parse assets-manifest.json redundantly and overwrite the cache.

getCalendarCredentials in packages/core/CalendarManager.ts calls the now-async getCalendar without await. The returned `calendar` field is therefore a `Promise<Calendar | null>`, which is always truthy and so passes `if (!calendar)` checks, and discarded promises that reject are unhandled.
The routes provide the group id in params[:id], but the controller reads params[:group_id], causing a param-missing failure.
Adding render :show inside perform_show_response renders the template before topics#show sets canonical_url, so server-rendered topic pages lose their <link rel="canonical"> tag.
The computed property depends on rejectedEmails.@each, which may not recompute on pushObject of primitive string items.

sendAddGuestsEmails does not check the event type's disableStandardEmails settings, and the handler does not pass booking.eventType?.metadata. Emails are therefore sent even when standard host/attendee emails are disabled.

In TopicsController#unsubscribe, TopicUser.find_by can return nil when the user has no topic_users row for the topic. The next line calls tu.notification_level without a nil check, which raises and returns a 500.
ExampleIntegration.sync_status_outbound has no **kwargs, so it raises TypeError when called with the new assignment_source argument.

In FilterView.tsx, inside rules.map(...), the 'grafana' branch renders <GrafanaRuleListItem> without key={key>. The sibling branches (DataSourceRuleLoader, UnknownRuleListItem) and the removed GrafanaRuleLoader pass the key.
The multi-layer feature (17 files, DB migration, data-deletion endpoint, UI replacement) was not tested end-to-end against a real Google Calendar integration.

OrderedQueueWorker.run calls complete_offset in its finally block, so offsets of items whose result_processor raised are still committed, contradicting the docstring 'Only commits offsets after successful processing'. test_thread_queue_parallel_error_handling asserts no commit after an error and passes only because it checks before the first 1s commit tick.

Per-group resources are created without a type, because getOrCreateResource() never calls setType. As a result, findByType(server, 'Groups', ...) returns only the all-groups type resource and not the per-group resources.
The override end boundary uses strict isAfter while the start boundary uses isBefore || isSame. A slot starting exactly at the override end time passes the check and is marked available.

The annotation cleanup closures in xorm_store.go contain six r.log.Error calls (lines 534/537/554/557/576/579) that log routine operational information. These calls fire at Error level on every batch, including successful and empty ones.

googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts stores the entire parseRefreshTokenResponse safeParse wrapper ({success, data, ...}) as Credential.key instead of its .data. The next googleCredentialSchema.parse(credential.key) then throws.

ClientPermissionsV2.getClientsWithPermission uses findByType(server, 'Clients'). This matches only the typed all-clients resource, because per-client resources are created without a type. As a result it never returns per-client IDs and may return the string 'Clients', which callers such as AvailableRoleMappingResource pass to realm.getClientById.
The embed iframe passes request.referer, a full URL, as postMessage's targetOrigin instead of an origin (scheme://host[:port]). The parent page therefore does not receive the resize messages.
findMembers() is called asynchronously without its promise being returned or awaited from setupController, so the template may render before member data is available.

In GoogleCalendarService updateEvent (line ~256) and deleteEvent (line ~317), the fallback `destinationCalendar.find(cal => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)` runs only when externalCalendarId is falsy, so it never matches. As a result, updateEvent sends an undefined calendarId, and deleteEvent falls back to 'primary' instead of the booking's destination calendar.
On the unsubscribe page, {{title}} is interpolated into an HTML translation and inserted with triple-stash without escaping, which allows XSS.
No test covers the fan-out over multiple destination calendars, the reference credentialId/externalId mapping, or multi-reference update/cancel/reschedule.
The migration backfill interpolates legacy host strings directly into raw SQL (VALUES ('#{h}', ...)) without quoting or parameter binding. A value containing a single quote aborts the migration.
queue.Queue.shutdown(immediate=False) and queue.ShutDown exist only in Python 3.13+, so the code fails on earlier Python versions.
The limit and offset params on the members endpoint are not validated or clamped: negative values reach SQL and cause errors, and limit has no upper cap.

The upsampling cache keys are built with Python's built-in hash() of project IDs. hash() is process-dependent (PYTHONHASHSEED) and can collide, so keys do not match across workers and different project sets can share a key.

In addGuests.handler.ts, the team permission check uses `isTeamAdmin(...) && isTeamOwner(...)` where `||` is intended. This reduces it to an owner-only check, so team ADMINs who are not the organizer or an attendee get FORBIDDEN even though the variable is named isTeamAdminOrOwner.
The Dependabot label 'area/ci' does not exist.

In the credential webhook handler, appCredentialWebhookRequestBodySchema.parse(req.body), symmetricDecrypt and JSON.parse run without error handling. Malformed bodies, bad ciphertext, a wrong key or invalid JSON therefore return 500 instead of 4xx.
The label 'area/ci' does not exist for Dependabot to use.

The AdminPermissions role/client/group removal listener is guarded only by the V1 flag ADMIN_FINE_GRAINED_AUTHZ. When only ADMIN_FINE_GRAINED_AUTHZ_V2 is enabled, the permission cleanup block is skipped and permission resources are left orphaned.
The decrypted keys are written to credential.key without shape validation.
The identifier parameter of track_calls in test_results_consumer.py is unused, which triggers the Ruff linter.

parseRefreshTokenResponse switches to minimumTokenResponseSchema whenever credential sharing and the sync endpoint are configured, even when the refresh call still goes to the third-party provider (e.g. team credentials).

`MetricAlertDetectorHandler` subclasses `StatefulDetectorHandler` with only `pass` and implements none of its abstract members (`counter_names`, `get_dedupe_value`, `get_group_key_values`, `build_occurrence_and_event_data`). Instantiating it through `MetricAlertFire.detector_handler` / `Detector.detector_handler` therefore raises TypeError.

When fewer than failure_issue_threshold check-ins exist, previous_checkins[:failure_issue_threshold] returns a shorter list and the code still opens an incident. This contradicts the N-consecutive-failures threshold semantics; for example, a new monitor can get an incident on its first failure.

In packages/app-store/index.ts, appStore values are `import("./x")` expressions evaluated when the object literal is built. Importing appStore therefore loads all app packages immediately rather than lazily on key access.
The webhook header lookup uses CALCOM_WEBHOOK_HEADER_NAME as given. Node.js lowercases incoming header names, so a mixed-case configured name fails the lookup.

bleveBackend.TotalDocs iterates b.cache without holding cacheMu, while BuildIndex writes the map concurrently. Callers include the new startup log in searchSupport.init (after the watch goroutine starts) and BleveIndexMetrics.Collect on every scrape, so concurrent map iteration and write can cause a fatal runtime panic.

deleteScheduledEmailReminder is called with immediateDelete=true on workflow deletion, step deletion and reschedule. This performs direct SendGrid cancellation that bypasses the deferred cancellation flow and is subject to SendGrid's cancelled-batch limit.
SiteSetting.embed_by_username has .downcase called on it without a blank guard.
In packages/lib/payment/handlePayment.ts:26, the awaited appStore import has no error handling, so a failed import throws past the function without context.
_create_process_for_shard (lines 127-132) has no callers in src/ or tests/ and only delegates to _create_process_for_shards, so it is dead code.

TestLogger.FromContext returns a new instance via NewTestLogger() instead of the receiver f. Logs written through FromContext(ctx), such as those from LoggerMiddleware, go to a throwaway logger, so tests asserting on the original TestLogger see no calls.
Because the unsubscribe endpoint is a GET, email client link prefetchers can trigger it and change users' notification settings without the user acting.
V1/legacy, federated and impersonation token-exchange tokens are encoded with grant 'na' because these paths never set Constants.GRANT_TYPE (AbstractTokenExchangeProvider.java:410).
The denial cache key uses the raw checkReq.UserUID instead of the resolved userIdentifiers.UID used by getCachedIdentityPermissions.

The process-wide translation cache in I18n.translate (translate_accelerator.rb) is keyed only on the key, the locale and the backend object id. It does not include SiteSetting.default_locale or the site, even though FallbackLocaleList#[] puts the default locale in the fallback chain. As a result, stale fallback strings stay cached after an admin changes default_locale, and in multisite one site's fallback text is served to another site.
`.topic-list.categories .category .badge-notification` still uses bare `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%)` without dark-light-choose, so the conversion is incomplete.

The script uses the BSD/macOS-only `sed -i '' -E` syntax, which fails on GNU sed (Linux). When it fails, the .env update does not happen but the script still prints that GOOGLE_WEBHOOK_URL was updated.

In the working-hours check in checkIfIsAvailable, `end` is computed from slotStartTime instead of slotEndTime, so start and end are identical. A slot that starts inside working hours but runs past workingHour.endTime is not rejected.

In desktop/topic-post.scss, `.topic-meta-data h5 a` has its dark-light-choose arguments swapped. The original light-theme `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 30%)` became `dark-light-choose(70%, 30%)` instead of `(30%, 70%)`, so the light-theme link becomes much lighter and lower-contrast.

Fallbacks are now enabled in all environments, including development and test, instead of only production/profile/cloud66. This hides missing translations behind English text and can break specs that expect missing-translation output.
session.getProvider(TokenContextEncoderProvider.class) is used without a null check, so an NPE occurs during token issuance if the provider is not registered.

`navigator.clipboard.writeText()` is not awaited or error-handled, so the success toast shows even when the write fails. Where navigator.clipboard is undefined (plain-HTTP non-localhost), the click throws.

In SpanFlusher.join(), when the deadline expires the `break` exits the per-process loop before terminate() runs for the current and remaining flusher processes, leaving them running after join returns during shutdown/rebalance.
The commit format breaches CONTRIBUTING.md: there are two commits instead of one, ee2491268a uses lowercase 'closes #37118', and daffb05b5a has no issue link.

The documentation table describes exit code 4 as 'Rolling Upgrade is not possible'. Exit code 4 is also returned when the feature is disabled, with the message 'Unable to use this command...'. The table therefore conflates a disabled tool with a compatibility verdict and does not cover the metadata command returning 4.
The owasp-java-html-sanitizer dependency version 20240325.1 is outdated compared with 20260313.1.

OptimizedCursorPaginator.value_from_cursor returns the raw integer cursor.value without converting it back to a datetime as DateTimePaginator does. build_queryset therefore compares a datetime field against an integer on subsequent pages.

ContextualLoggerMiddleware's QueryData, CallResource, CheckHealth and CollectMetrics dereference req.PluginContext with no nil check on req, so a nil request panics. Other middlewares, including LoggerMiddleware, guard against nil requests.

The age/timestamp mutual-exclusion validators in BrowserReportSerializer use the truthiness of self.initial_data.get(...). A value of 0 is therefore treated as absent, and age=0 combined with timestamp passes validation.

In `test_state_results_multi_group`, the expected occurrence for `group_2` is built with `value=6`, while the data packet has `group_2=10`. The test passes only because the value is not used when the occurrence is constructed.
No documentation is added for the Clients resource type or its scopes.
email_in_restriction_setting? evaluates value =~ regexp, which raises when value is nil (e.g. missing email param); validate_each does not guard against blank/nil values.

The template is at templates/topic/unsubscribe.hbs, which resolves to a nested topic.unsubscribe route. The router, controller and view use the top-level topicUnsubscribe route, so Ember will not pick up the template.
response.getLocation() can be null even with a 201 status, which causes an NPE when parsing the path.
EmbeddableHost's before_validation calls self.host.sub! without a nil guard. A missing host raises NoMethodError (500) instead of producing a validation error.

In ensure_loaded!, the lazy initialization `@loaded_locales ||= []` is not protected by LOAD_MUTEX. Concurrent threads read and write @loaded_locales without synchronization, which can cause lost writes or double loading.
ENV_FILE="../.env" is resolved relative to the caller's current working directory, so running the script from the repo root writes GOOGLE_WEBHOOK_URL to the wrong .env file, outside the repo.

The AdminPermissions cleanup listener for role/client/group removal is registered only when ADMIN_FINE_GRAINED_AUTHZ (V1) is enabled. In V2-only deployments, removed roles, clients and groups leave orphaned authorization resources and permissions.
The shared PasswordField show/hide toggle button has tabIndex={-1}, which removes it from keyboard tab order for every password field.
The 'upsampled_count' SnQLFunction lambda has an unused parameter named 'args' instead of '_'.
The default-strategy test case returns before the rolling-updates feature flag is enabled, so the `null` branch no longer covers the rolling-update path.
The label 'area/dependencies' does not exist for Dependabot to use.
Line 413 contains the typo 'Succesful' instead of 'Successful'.
In rest.js.es6, type.replace('_', '-') replaces only the first underscore, so a type containing several underscores resolves to the wrong base path.
The PR adds no tests for the new i18n fallback system, including FallbackLocaleList#[], FallbackLocaleList#ensure_loaded!, I18n.ensure_loaded!, the fallback order, and fallback/cache interaction.
The init error is logged twice with the identical message 'error initializing resource server', once inside Init and once in NewResourceServer, and is also returned to the caller.
